# Test fixtures

Small files used by the automated tests. Every file is either generated by our own code or a
public-domain / CC0 photo, listed below with its source and license.

## Generated (`generate-fixtures.browser.test.ts`)

Written in real Chromium by `generate-fixtures.browser.test.ts` with the helpers in `writers.ts`
(EXIF, GIF and BMP writers). Regenerate with:

```sh
VITE_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 pnpm vitest run --project browser tests/fixtures/generate-fixtures.browser.test.ts
```

Without `VITE_WRITE_FIXTURES=1` the generator is skipped. License: same as the project (AGPL-3.0).

### `images/`

| File                                      | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `orientation-1.jpg` … `orientation-8.jpg` | 96×64 test card (red top-left, green top-right, blue bottom-left, yellow bottom-right) stored so that applying EXIF orientation _n_ makes it upright. EXIF: Make/Model, dates with `+02:00` offset, no GPS |
| `gps.jpg`                                 | Upright test card with a GPS block (51°30′N, 0°7′W)                                                                                                                                                        |
| `no-exif.jpg`                             | Upright test card, no EXIF at all                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `alpha.png`                               | 90×60: transparent left third, 50 % transparent blue middle, opaque orange right                                                                                                                           |
| `opaque.png`                              | 90×60 test card, fully opaque                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `sample.webp`                             | 80×60 test card, lossy WebP                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `sample.avif`                             | 80×60 test card, AVIF (encoded with jSquash)                                                                                                                                                               |
| `sample.gif`                              | 40×30, two frames: test card, then all white (first frame must be used)                                                                                                                                    |
| `sample.bmp`                              | 50×30 test card, 24-bit bottom-up BMP (odd row padding)                                                                                                                                                    |

### `quality/` (synthetic members of the reference set)

| File                  | What it is                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sky-gradient.png`    | 2400×1600 smooth sky gradient with a soft glow; neighbouring pixels differ by ≤ 1 level (banding check)                                                           |
| `text-screenshot.png` | 1600×1000 settings-page screenshot: text from 11 to 32 px, serif, monospace, 1 px table rules                                                                     |
| `line-art-logo.png`   | 2000×2000 logo, word mark, fan of 1–4 px lines, mid-grey panel for halo checks (96 / 176 levels), 1 px and 1.5 px line gratings and a zone plate for moiré checks |

## Reference quality set

The seven files in `quality/` are the reference set from the image quality standard
(`docs/03-features.md`): photo with fine detail (hair, foliage), night photo with noise,
product on white, smooth sky gradient, text screenshot, logo/line art, portrait phone photo
with EXIF rotation. Each is under 3 MB.
